environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with WebSocket sticky sessions enabled. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the container on port 3000. No origin access restrictions. The service is directly reachable via the ALB DNS name. JWT_SECRET is set to 'development-secret-key' (default). No WAF rules attached to the ALB.

config.load_balancer: ALB with WebSocket support, no WAF
config.network: Public subnet, ALB DNS publicly resolvable
config.origin_access: unrestricted - any client can connect directly to ALB
